name: Motion mask loop
summary: A process that freezes a video except for one masked region, which repeats in a seamless loop.
how: Shoot on a tripod so that the still region does not drift by more than 1px.
Mask the moving region with a soft edge of 4px to 12px.
Join the loop with a cross-fade of 4 to 8 frames at the loop point.

origin.note: Jamie Beck and Kevin Burg publish the first cinemagraphs and use the name.

adoptions.via: The pair shows cinemagraphs of fashion week on Tumblr; brands and photographers copy the form.
